text_block_list.text:
On the way home after spending the day
out with
Mihono Bourbon, we spot a
festival at a nearby
shrine.

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text:
Detecting that congestion is at five
times normal
levels. In other words, it is
a huge turnout.

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text:
No. I was merely scanning for which
stalls have the highest customer density,
as my data banks
currently lack this
information.
choice_data_list: Curious?

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text:
The yakisoba stall appears the most
crowded.
This is peculiar, considering it
can be prepared at
home.
Groooowl...

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text:
The visual input has stimulated my
stomach,
creating a natural bodily
reflex.

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text:
Understood. If that is your desire, then I
will
accompany you.
choice_data_list: Let's go check out the food stalls!

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text: Munch, munch... Gulp...

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text:
Delicious. The yakisoba is "piping hot,"
just as the stall's name suggests.
However, it has a richer
flavor than
regular yakisoba.
choice_data_list: Is it good?
Is it delicious?

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text: I wonder if the other food stalls share the same phenomenon... Gulp...

text_block_list.name: Shooting Gallery Att...
text_block_list.text:
Come one, come all! Help your digestion
along with a little target practice at the
shooting gallery, and win some fabulous
prizes while you're
at it!

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text: Hm?

text_block_list.name: Shooting Gallery Att...
text_block_list.text:
The nigh-unobtainable grand prize is a 
take-all-you-want ticket! You'll be sure
to please
that special someone at your
side!

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text:
Trainer, since you resolved my empty
stomach dilemma, I would like to
request permission to
grant your desires
next.

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text:
This shooting gallery seems to have the
perfect
prize that will let me show you
my gratitude.

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text:
This shooting gallery seems to have the
perfect
prize that will let me show you
my gratitude.
choice_data_list: Then shall we try the shooting gal...
Then let's try the shooting gallery.
No, let's eat our way through the ...

text_block_list.text:
She starts shooting in an attempt to win
the grand
prize, but...
choice_data_list: Then shall we try the shooting gal...
Then let's try the shooting gallery.
No, let's eat our way through the ...

text_block_list.name: Spectator
text_block_list.text:
Aw, missed again. She's failed ten times,
but she's
still not giving up.

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text:
Adjusting range by five millimeters.
Adding three
degrees to firing angle...
Recalculating
trajectory...

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text:
...Understood. I have no issue. Because
the next
shot will be the last.
choice_data_list: We have curfew too, so let's head ...

text_block_list.text: Bang! Thunk.

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text: Target destroyed.

text_block_list.name: Spectator
text_block_list.text: Whoooa! She totally called that one!

text_block_list.name: Shooting Gallery Att...
text_block_list.text:
Haha! Looks like it's your victory, young
lady!
Take as many prizes as you want!

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text:
Very well, then. Trainer, what would you
like?

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text: Whatever I want?
choice_data_list: Pick whatever you like, Bourbon!

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text: Understood. Please wait.

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text:
I selected matching items that I think are
perfect
for us. Here.

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text: I hope it fits your hand.

I remove the prize from the box and
gently hold
it.

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text:
What do you think? It's a hand grip. How
does it
feel?

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text:
Excellent. Now we can train and improve

together.
choice_data_list: Looking good...?

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text: Mission complete.

We return to the academy while working
out with
our matching hand grips.

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text:
That is only what I desire, and thus, it
will only
benefit me... It is no way to
thank you.

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text: You want to see me happy...
choice_data_list: That's my wish.
That's my wish.

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text:
Understood. I will eat with all my might
if that is
what you wish.

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text:
Commencing food stall conquest. Let's
start with
that taiyaki stall.

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text: Munch, munch...

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text:
Report—flavors are beyond expected
levels,
resulting in a short-circuit in my
thought process.
choice_data_list: Wh-What's wrong?
Wh-What's wrong?

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text:
I am unable to identify any special
cooking
techniques or seasoning used...
This must be an
ordinary taiyaki.

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text:
Similar to the yakisoba, its deliciousness

perplexes me. Why does eating it make
me feel
so elated?

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text: I see. I have seen data on this before.
choice_data_list: Because it's fun, maybe?

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text:
Feelings and flavor can operate
together. I
believe the words were
"happiness is the best
seasoning."

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text:
Let us have okonomiyaki next. I am
intrigued as
to whether it will surpass my
expectations as well.

We continue ordering from the food
stalls.

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text: Burp... Consumption of cotton candy complete.

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text:
We've visited every stall, and my energy
levels
are fully replenished.

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text:
What about you, Trainer? Did the
experience
meet your expectations?

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text:
Then my mission is complete. Currently
saving this
experience to my memory
logs.
choice_data_list: Of course! It was so much fun!
Of course! It was a lot of fun!

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text:
Recording today's events along with all
the
various culinary experiences that I
enjoyed with
you.

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text:
I feel like if I access these logs,
I'll be
able to run
up the steepest incline
indefinitely.

Today's food doesn't only replenish
Mihono
Bourbon's energy levels, but
also fills her heart
with joy.
